findings.passage: "All voters deserve to participate in free and fair elections. Wisconsin law already requires voters to present photographic identification at the polls. Amending our constitution should be reserved for matters of true significance, not partisan gamesmanship."
findings.note: Statement issued in her name after the Assembly vote on Assembly Joint Resolution 1 (put the existing voter ID law into the state constitution). She notes photo ID is already required by law and says constitutional changes should be for matters of true significance.
